GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.33 (15 Jan 47) GC
(SCAPIN - 1470)
APO 500
15 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Japanese Criminals from Korea.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum from the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file AG 014.33 (7 Jan 47)GC, (SCAPIN 1442), dated 7 January 1947, subject as above.
2. The Tachibana Maru is designated to repatriate the fifteen (15) Japanese criminals, now imprisoned in Korea. The ship will depart from Hakata on or about 15 January 1947. The return port in Japan is Sasebo.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government will comply with the provisions of reference paragraph 1 above.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
